attempts.summary: Created an LVM volume group (datavg) and logical volume (datalv) on node1 backed by a file-backed loop device (since the node's single disk had no free space/spare disk), formatted it XFS, mounted at /srv/data, then grew it online from 1000M to <2.15GiB (>2GB) via pvresize + lvextend -r while it stayed mounted, preserving contents (verified by checksum before/after). Made the setup persistent across reboot with a systemd oneshot service that reattaches the loop device and activates the VG before local-fs mounting, referenced from /etc/fstab via x-systemd.requires. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the LV, mount, and file checksums all recovered correctly post-reboot.
